Definition: from G1717; to exhibit (in person) or disclose (by words):--appear, declare (plainly), inform, (will) manifest, shew, signify.
BiblicalUsage: Emphanizo is to show or declare plainly — in person or in words. The conspirators ask the council to signify to the chief captain in Acts 23:15, Christ appears in the presence of God for us in Hebrews 9:24, and Jesus promises to manifest Himself to the one who keeps His commandments in John 14:21. After His resurrection, the saints came out of the graves and appeared unto many in Matthew 27:53.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God is not hidden — He shows Himself, in Christ standing before the Father for us and in the quiet manifestation to a heart that obeys. I hold that the God who appears is the God who keeps His promises in the open, where anyone can see.
